ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extreme low-intensity bias; approximately 95% of the visible surface consists of low-intensity pixels (black/dark grey) with <5% high-intensity pixels (white/bright) occurring as localized spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly dark low-intensity manifold across the primary surface area. High-contrast white circular spots (rosettes) are spatially mapped along the upper leading edges of both lobes and distributed across the mid-region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate vertex angle of 42 degrees and a depth ratio of 0.12 relative to the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge; the right lobe displays high-amplitude jagged peaks (5-10 pixel depth), while the left lobe shows lower-frequency, shallower serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curvature along the leading edges, tapering sharply to acute lateral apexes at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely clustered white circular pixel groups (rosettes) with diameters ranging from 2-6 pixels, concentrated on the upper-left lobe and the peripheral margin of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent high-intensity pixel clusters at both the left and right distal tips indicating localized surface trauma or calcified accretions; extensive white circular scarring across the dark ventral field.
